title: Teleport-Portal
description: Teleport-Portal is a premium-grade utility plugin designed to streamline player-to-player teleportation with a beautiful, immersive interface.
body:
🔮 Teleport-Portal
Cinematic Player-to-Player Teleports.

⚡ Features
Visual GUI: Use /tpp to select players via a head-menu.

Action Bar: Clean countdown above the hotbar (no chat spam).

Anti-Cheese: Teleport cancels if the player moves.

Bilingual: Toggle between EN and DE in the config.

🎮 Commands
/tpp — Open the Portal Menu

/accept — Connect to a request

/tpdecline — Reject a request

Permissions: Use teleportme.use for all commands.

⚙️ Config

language:          # "de" or "en"

cooldown-seconds: 120   # Cooldown time

🚀 Installation
Drop the .jar into your /plugins folder.

Restart the server.

Configure your language in config.yml.
